scope: Unpublished neutral-candidate installer archives; inventory only, not a legal compliance determination

windowsX64.vendoredDependencyLicenses: Present in the locked runtime archive under payload/runtime/vendor and payload/runtime/PhpManager; not exhaustively evaluated here.

toolchain.distributionBoundary: Toolchain components are fetched into the user's private directory after installation, rather than all being bundled in these installer archives.

releaseGate: Before public publication, check third-party notices and obligations for each distributed runtime and the produced static ELF against the exact locked upstream versions. File presence alone is not proof of license compliance.
